subject.title: fix(plugins): pretag pack checks stop hanging on stalled commands

question: Should plugin pretag runtime-build, npm-pack, and ClawHub-pack stages uniformly fail after ten minutes for existing plugin publishers?
rationale: The patch fixes orphaned descendants by adding a hard deadline, but whether valid long-running release stages may now fail is an upgrade and release-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the uniform deadline
options.body: Accept the ten-minute ceiling as the supported release-pretag contract and merge with the existing process-tree proof.

options.title: Use a narrower policy
options.body: Keep managed execution but limit hard timeouts to the stages or invocation modes for which release tooling can confirm that ten minutes is safe.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the timeout behavior until release tooling defines the supported duration and operator recovery path.

recommendation.title: Approve the uniform deadline
recommendation.body: Accept the ten-minute ceiling as the supported release-pretag contract and merge with the existing process-tree proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed participant connected to the proposed implementation; a release-tooling owner should make the substantive decision.
